title: Effectivity of direct image of a coherent reduction system
statement: Let ell be prime, E/Q_ell finite, and X,Y finite-type schemes over a field K₀ in which ell is invertible, with f:X→Y a K₀-morphism. Use the actual sectionwise strict quotient-system direct image and normalized reduction and reconstruction calculus. For every normalized IntegralComparisonCoefficientData D and every K in the intrinsic bounded constructible derived-complete integral category on X, the whole-system counit of D.system Y is an isomorphism at the total derived system direct image of (D.system X).reduction(K). This assertion is made before a horizontal pullback or the alpha comparison. Additivity of the actual ordinary system direct image and K-injective resolutions of the source system category are the usual categorical assumptions for its total right derived functor; the parent module proves these instances.

theorem systemDirectImage_effective
    (K₀ : Type u) [Field K₀] (hl : IsUnit (l : K₀))
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of K₀))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [(integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).Additive]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions (coefficientSequenceModules l E X)]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : IntegralComparisonCoefficientData l E) (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    IsIso ((D.system Y).adjunction.counit.app
      ((integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((D.system X).reduction.obj K.obj)))
